scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @waterclip/server" "npm run dev -w @waterclip/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @waterclip/server && npm run typecheck -w @waterclip/web
